description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Colombo and the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Maldives with the objective of Academic Collaboration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Colombo and the Republic of Maldives with a view to enhancing cooperation in the field of postgraduate education and providing training for doctors and dental surgeons of the Maldives in Sri Lanka. In addition to the health professional training programme, it is expected to obtain the assistance of the Postgraduate Institute of Medicine in Sri Lanka to recruit specialist medical practitioners required for the Maldives on a short-term or long-term basis in accordance with a separate Agreement to be entered into between the two parties. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Colombo and the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Maldives, was approved by the Cabinet.
